theories.claim: beginDurableCLICommand passes empty digest to AcceptOperation, disabling confirmation-digest deduplication for CLI durability
theories.basis: internal/app/durable_operations.go:49-59 beginDurableCLICommand calls manager.AcceptOperation(deps.ctx, Confirmation{Request:request}, "") with empty digest; durable_operations.go:106 only attempts ResolveOperationAlias deduplication when digest != "" && errors.Is(err, ErrConflict). CLI path therefore never coalesces, while web path passes digest and test TestDurableOperationDeduplicatesAcrossManagersAndFailsClosed expects dedup with "same-confirmation-digest".
theories.verification_surface: Concurrent or retried CLI invocations with identical OperationRequest; inspect repository.Accept conflict handling and owned map
theories.confirmation_condition: File read shows empty string literal passed; requires confirming repository.Accept conflict path is reachable for CLI kind
theories.refutation_condition: Empty digest is intentional and CLI durability is documented as non-idempotent, or separate CLI idempotency layer exists
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot confirm runtime observable duplicate RunID creation without executing runcontrol SQLite workflow; static read alone shows code path but not impact
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only file reads of durable_operations.go:49-59, 97-112 and durable_operations_test.go dedup test; request no process launch, inspect only assigned changed/context paths

theories.claim: Web QAIssue lookup only scans first 200 issues, causing false ErrNotFound for issues beyond first page
theories.basis: internal/app/web_usecases.go:885-902 QAIssue calls QAIssues(ctx, QARequest{Limit:200}) then linear scan of page.Items; no pagination loop or cursor continuation. QAIssues paginates with limit 1..200 and nextCursor, but QAIssue ignores it.
theories.verification_surface: Call QAIssue with issue ID that lies beyond offset 200 in QAAdjudication issues list; observe error "issue is not owned by the current QA attempt" despite ownership
theories.confirmation_condition: Static file read confirms single-page scan with fixed limit 200 and no loop; reproduced by inspecting web_usecases.go:892-899
theories.refutation_condition: File shows QAIssue iterates all pages or uses direct lookup by ID in adjudication store
theories.inconclusive_condition: File not readable or adjudication storage pagination semantics differ from bounded() collection
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only file read of web_usecases.go QAIssue/QAIssues plus web_usecases_test.go collection limits; no process execution, no fixture mutation
